# Provenance of WEF event fixtures

Generated by `scripts/wef_fixtures_from_evtx.sh` (re-runnable). Each file is the first matching
record of the given sample, converted with `evtx_dump -o xml` (evtx 0.12.3), banner (`<?xml?>`,
`Record N`) stripped, one `<Event>` element per file. No other normalisation; bytes are as dumped
(plus a trailing newline).

Source: https://github.com/omerbenamram/evtx, commit
`7479d02dfaa3bdeb41c5ea87195e84116a032cfc`, directory `samples/`. Licence: Apache-2.0
(Copyright the evtx authors; used unmodified as test data, licensed under
http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).

| Fixture | Sample file | Record |
|---|---|---|
| security_4624.xml | security_big_sample.evtx | Security 4624 |
| security_4625.xml | Security_short_selected.evtx | Security 4625 |
| security_4688.xml | security_big_sample.evtx | Security 4688 |
| security_4768.xml | security_big_sample.evtx | Security 4768 |
| security_4769.xml | security_big_sample.evtx | Security 4769 |
| security_4672.xml | security_big_sample.evtx | Security 4672 |
| sysmon_1.xml | sysmon.evtx | Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational 1 |
| sysmon_3.xml | sysmon.evtx | Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational 3 |
| system_7045.xml | system.evtx | System 7045 |

Command per file: `evtx_dump -o xml <sample>` then first `<Event>` with the wanted Channel/EventID.

## Synthetic (derived, not real captures)

- `synth_illegal_char.xml`: copy of `security_4624.xml` with U+0004 inserted at the start of the
  first `<Data>` value (an XML-1.0-illegal character).
- `rendered_7045.xml`: `system_7045.xml` plus a hand-written `<RenderingInfo>` block.

## Not available

- PowerShell 4104 (`Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational`): not in any permitted EVTX sample
  in the evtx repo. OTRF Security-Datasets (MIT, commit
  `d9d40ef123d2c87d5d3df28c96bcab4f0faccc87`) contains no `.evtx` files; its datasets are JSON
  zips without raw event XML. EVTX-ATTACK-SAMPLES (GPL-3) is excluded by policy. Not synthesised.
